subject: POC kickoff & success criteria - Acme Industries
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@acme.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-15T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: POC kickoff & success criteria - Acme Industries

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick post-call recap and proposed next steps to keep momentum on the POC. Please review and confirm the items below so we can lock in the kickoff date.

1) Agreed success criteria (provisional)
- Latency: 95th percentile < 200 ms on the evaluation workload (sample dataset attached)
- Throughput: sustain 20 req/s with <250ms tail for 1 minute sustained bursts
- Accuracy: NIST-style hit-rate on the labeled test set >= 88% (we'll exchange labels/test set)
- Cost target: projected cost per 1M tokens under $60 (Redwood will optimize batching/quantization)

2) Evaluation plan
- Duration: 2-week hands-on trial environment
- Data: Acme provides a representative sample dataset and acceptance test scripts (we'll sign an NDA if needed)
- Ownership: Marissa (Redwood) will own infra + model config; Jordan (Acme) will own test dataset and end-to-end validation

3) Timeline & milestones (proposed)
- Kickoff & environment access: Week of Mar 22 (propose Mon 3/23)
- Week 1: baseline runs + integration (daily async updates)
- Week 2: optimization, regression checks, and final readout prep
- Final readout: Fri Apr 3 — short presentation of metrics, issues, and go/no-go recommendation
- Weekly sync: Wed 30 min stand-up during the POC (Marissa, Jordan, Rishi optional)

4) Next steps (what Redwood will deliver by kickoff)
- Share POC checklist and SOW stub (attached)
- Provision trial environment and short-lived API keys
- Provide test harness and baseline metrics within 48h of dataset arrival

Attachments: redwood-poc-checklist.pdf, redwood-sow-stub.docx
Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-poc-materials, HubSpot: https://hubspot.example/contacts/ACME-12345

If you can confirm the success criteria and the kickoff week (we've penciled in Mon 3/23 but flexible), I'll send the calendar invite and loop in our security lead for the questionnaire.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & success criteria - Acme Industries

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. A couple of quick notes/questions from our side:

- Success criteria: the latency/throughput targets look reasonable. For operational tolerance, our SREs asked if we can relax the latency to 95th < 250 ms (as long as P50/P95 trends are consistent) — fine to use 250ms as the acceptance threshold if you think it's achievable.
- Dataset: we'll send a 10k sample and the acceptance script by EOD Tue 3/17.
- Security: we need a completed security questionnaire before we provision test data. Can you have someone from security reach out?
- Kickoff: we have an internal all-hands Mon 3/23 and would prefer Tue 3/24 for the kickoff (morning PST). Any chance we can do Tue 3/24 10:00am PST?

Also, please include any instructions for volume simulation — we plan to simulate bursts up to 50 req/s to see degradation points.

Thanks,
Jordan
Product Manager, Acme Industries
jordan.price@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@acme.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-16T11:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & success criteria - Acme Industries

Jordan — perfect, thanks for the heads up. Confirming the adjustments and next steps:

- Acceptance latency updated: 95th < 250 ms (accepted)
- Kickoff scheduled: Tue 2026-03-24 at 10:00am PST — I'll send an invite after you confirm the attendee list
- Security questionnaire: looping in Monica Patel (security/compliance) — Monica, can you send our standard questionnaire and an estimated turnaround for completion?
- Volume simulation: we'll provide a load generator guide; Rishi will set up a burst test harness so you can drive up to 50 req/s during a controlled window.

I've attached the POC checklist and a short SOW stub (redwood-sow-stub.docx) to speed contracting if we need a short commercial agreement.

Next steps for Acme: share sample dataset + acceptance script (by EOD 3/17). For Redwood: security questionnaire + provisioning steps (Monica / Rishi).

Best —
Marissa

Subject: Internal: Acme POC — infra & security prep

Team — quick internal note to align before kickoff on 3/24. Jordan confirmed 10am PST on Tue 3/24. Items:

- Rishi: please provision a trial environment (ephemeral cluster) using the "dedicated-fleet-small" profile. We want to ensure we can reproduce the baseline within 24h of dataset arrival. Also, prepare the burst harness and brief runbook (how we'll step from 20 -> 50 req/s).
- Camila: coordinate integration steps and provide the test harness instructions we'll send to Acme (include example cURL and a small python client).
- Monica: please send the security questionnaire to jordan.price@acme.com and priya.shah@acme.com and flag any items that will need additional evidence (SOC 2 artifacts / logs) — ETA for questionnaire: EOD 3/18.
- Commercial: keep the SOW stub handy; if Acme signs the short SOW before kickoff, we'll enable longer-lived keys and slightly higher throughput caps.

I'll drive the kickoff agenda and calendar invite. Thanks —
Marissa
